text: Hello and welcome to our live coverage of the Premier League clash between Sheffield United and Fulham.
Having conceded the most goals for any team this season and languishing at the bottom of the table, Sheffield United were anyway struggling.
But they come into this game probably feeling even more bruised after the events at the Vitality Stadium in their last game before the international break.

After a spell of three games before that one in which they did not score at all and conceded a combined 12 goals, the Blades finally scored before seeing a two-goal advantage slip into a 2-2 draw against Bournemouth.
However, the task only gets tougher against the in-form Cottagers.
Fulham’s results in their last four games define their season so far in a way.
A loss to Wolves is sandwiched between wins against Manchester United, Brighton, and most recently Tottenham.
However, they have great momentum right now after beating Tottenham 3-0 at Craven Cottage in their latest outing before the break.
The Cottagers have European football in their sights and will see this meeting with struggling Sheffield United as a huge chance to climb up the table.
They have no new injury issues and will bank on Rodrigo Muniz’s supreme form to continue.
Chris Wilder makes three changes to his Sheffield United side from the 2-2 draw against Bournemouth three weeks ago.
Mason Holgate and Anel Ahmedhodzic replace Auston Trusty and the injured George Baldock in defence.
Also, Vinicius Souza is in for Tom Davies.
Marco Silva names an unchanged Fulham side from their 3-0 win over Tottenham just before the break.
Adarabioyo and Bassey continue as centre-backs, while the in-form Muniz starts up front.
The teams are making their way out to the pitch.
Fulham, who won the reverse fixture 3-1 at Craven Cottage back in October, have won just two of 14 away Premier League fixtures this season.
However, they will fancy their chances of handing Sheffield United a fourth consecutive home league defeat.
KICK-OFF! Bramall Lane is ready for action, the managers have their customary (and quite respectful) embrace, and Sheffield United kick us off in the first-half.
Not much action in the first couple of minutes with both teams enjoying a bit of the ball.
Remember, Sheffield United have won just one of their five Premier League games against Fulham.
Fulham doing most of the running so far.
They get into the box through Lukic who looks to find Muniz, but not much trouble for Sheffield United who clear.
First free-kick to the Blades on the halfway line as Tosin fouls Brereton to the floor.
The ball finds its way towards Brereton who guides it towards goal, but Leno calmly collects.
Now on the other side.
Robinson's strong long-range effort is saved by Grbic.
McBurnie catches Palhinha with a late tackle and its Fulham now who have their first free-kick of this match.
Pereira takes it from a somewhat dangerous position and finds Tosin, but Fulham cannot capitalise.
Fulham with a bit more threat in a last couple of minutes.
Pereira again in the thick of it, this time with a lovely outside-of-the-foot ball to Willian.
To no avail though.
United already looking caught out a bit and both Iwobi and Castagne looking good down the right for Fulham.
Willian is taken down after a cross comes towards him, but nothing given by the referee.
Fulham are looking to complete their first league double over Sheffield United since 2017-18 in the Championship.
Another free-kick in the middle of the pitch to the Blades.
Grbic comes up to take it but Fulham deal with it.
No fuss.
Good goalkeeping! Grbic does well to beat Castagne off a lovely through-ball from Iwobi.
Robinson's strong arm shoots a good throw-in straight into the box, but Leno punches it away.
Fulham threatening but not making the most of it yet.
Palhinha tries his luck from long range but it sails way over the bar.
Free-kick and wasted! A good chance this for Sheffield United as they win a free-kick from dangerous territory just outside the box.
However, Osborn overhits it to Ahmedhodzic who cannot do much and it is out for goal-kick.
Fulham again controlling possession and some shouts from the visitors for a hand-ball in the box but no importance given to it.
Brereton is fouled again, and the referee quickly gives a free-kick in favour of the Blades.
But as has been the case so far, they once again waste the opportunity.
Willian picks out Lukic who makes a very smart run, but Ahmedhodzic is quick to come across and block the threat.
A very scary looking coming together just outside the Sheffield United box between two players - unclear who was involved - but both thankfully look unscathed.
Fulham dominating possession with 76 per cent so far.
They would like that but also be a bit frustrated to have not yet capitalised on it.
First shot on target for the hosts.
Another very long throw-in from Robinson, Ahmedhodzic hits it goalwards but Leno very comfortably saves.
Strong again from Fulham down the left.
But again, nothing comes out of it.
First Pereira then Iwobi both have shots saved by Sheffield.
OFF THE POST! Impressive stop from Grbic.
Muniz, Fulham's star goalscorer, finds his way to the six-yard area and takes a shot at goal, before the keeper gets a hand on it and the ball clips the post.
Willian causing problems for Sheffield United.
The former Chelsea man wins a free-kick outside the box on the left.
The resulting set-piece finds Iwobi whose weak effort is easily collected by Grbic.
Fulham have been quite impressive, something they have not quite enjoyed away from home a lot this season.
Need more clarity and conviction in the final third though.
Late corner in the first-half to Sheffield United.
Bogle wins it as his shot hits Tosin's heel on the way out.
Can they make it count?
One minute of stoppage time added in the first-half.
WIDE! Better from Sheffield United though.
The corner was weak but Hamer collects the ball and whips a shot wide of the far post from the edge of the box.
HALF-TIME: SHEFFIELD UNITED 0-0 FULHAM
A first-half of few chances but not much excitement and quality.
Fulham definitely looked the better team, particularly down the left, and dominated possession.
The best chance of the half fell to Muniz, who found the post off a good save by Grbic.
Sheffield United had their brightest moment just before half-time through Hamer, but his shot flew just wide.
A more thrilling second half in store? We shall soon find out.
Fulham, to no one's surprise, leading the xG ratings from that first-half.
The visitors had an xG of 0.51 in the half to the Blades' 0.19.
They also had eight shots on goal (three on target) to Sheffield United's four (one on target).
Fulham have stronger options off the bench as well, so they would feel confident despite not having converted so far.
Stay tuned for the second half.
KICK-OFF! We are back underway at Bramall Lane as Fulham get things going in the second-half.
No changes from either side just yet.
Muniz wins a corner for Fulham within mere seconds of the restart.
He holds his ankle in some pain after that, but looks fine.
OFF THE POST! Muniz the man once again and his header this time finds the post.
A briliant right-wing cross from Pereira finds the forward, who is not in the best of positions, but makes decent contact.
SAVE! Arblaster with a crucial save.
Willian again troubles the Blades down the left, finds an unmarked Lukic in the box.
The midfielder's shot is saved by a sliding Arblaster.
The defender looks in a lot of pain after all that and is being treated upon.
Arblaster is up again after some treatment and looks fine to continue.
Meanwhile, Fulham continue the pressure and find another corner.
A much more intense start to this half so far.
Fulham already looking more confident in the final third.
Missed chance! Fulham through the left make another superb move through Robinson.
His low cross finds Iwobi who should have taken a shot but wastes time deciding.
Arblaster with another key save.
GOOOOOALLLL! The Blades against the run of play.

Tosin fluffs it in defense with a weak attempted pass, Sheffield United pounce down the left, McBurnie charges through and slots in a lovely ball to Brereton, who makes no mistake and taps it into an empty net.
Sheffield United 1-0 Fulham.
McBurnie punishes a loose pass from Tosin, runs down the left and plays a superb cross into the box.
Holgate is back in the team and is also back in the book.
Gets the game's first yellow card for a late challenge on Willian.
GOOOOOALLLL! Sheffield United's joy is short-lived and Fulham finally convert.
A Fulham corner is taken by Pereira down the right-wing.
He easily finds an unmarked Palhinha who hits a near-post header in the far corner.

text: Pereira easily finds Palhinha from a corner on the right-wing.
United looked asleep in defense, leaving Palhinha completely free.
Fulham add more threat after that equaliser.
Traore comes in for Lukic.
With that Fulham goal, Sheffield United have conceded 43 goals at home in the league this season, now only three short of the record for a single campaign.
GOOOOOALLLL! And the Blades respond! The crowd and the manager are absolutely ecstatic.
Sheffield United take a quick free-kick, completely catching Fulham off guard.
Brereton down the left plays it to McBurnie who slots it home.
Sheffield United 2-1 Fulham.
A quick free-kick from Sheffield United finds Brereton down the left, who returns the favour to McBurnie for the previous goal.
GOOOOOALLLL! Incredible from the hosts, they are now 3-1 up! Hamer with a great inswinging cross from the left and picks out Brereton.
However, there is a VAR check ongoing after a lot of confusion as it seemed the ball came off the goalscorer's arm.
After a couple of minutes of checking, the goal stands.
Sheffield United move the ball down the left and Hamer slots in a lovely inswinging cross to Brereton.
So much happening there! The goal from Brereton was deemed to be fair.
He clashed with Leno after that goal and there were some heated clashes there, but all seems to be sorted now.
In the middle of all that serious chaos, Cairney comes on for Iwobi.
A chance for Palhinha goes begging as his unimpressive effort flies wide of the far post.
Fulham have wasted a golden opportunity here.
They will rue all those missed chances especially in this second half.
All Sheffield United at the moment as they suddenly look very threatening.
Goal for Sheffield United but it is disallowed.
Fulham's defence just cannot clear their lines from a free kick, the ball then falls nicely to McBurnie just eight yards out and he takes it with open arms.
A VAR check was ongoing and it was disallowed for an offside on Souza in the build-up.
Still 3-1
Substitution! Tete is on for Castagne.
Change! Trusty is on for Souza.
More changes for Fulham.
Reid replaces Pereira.
Jimenez comes on for Adarabioyo
Cairney charges ahead from a quickly taken free-kick by Fulham.
He then finds Reid just outside the box, who slots it home.
GOOOOOALLLL! What a strike! Fulham are still in this and impact-sub Reid with a brilliant long-range strike brings Fulham back into it.
Gets the ball from Cairney and finds the bottom left corner of the goal from just outside the box.
Almost 4-1 to definitely 3-2 within no time, and now we could have a grandstand finale!
CHANCE! So close to a Fulham equaliser as Traore gets the ball on the right corner, cuts back inside, before smashing a curler inches past the far post.
Arblaster is subbed off and on comes Norwood.
Another among a wholesale of changes! McBurnie, the star of the day for the hosts, goes off, and on comes McAtee.
FOURTEEN minutes of added time to end an enthralling half.
Fulham now looking to make the most as Sheffield United look very nervy.
They win back-to-back corners and can smell an equaliser.

GOOOOOALLLL! An absolute screamer from Muniz! Wow! After an initially unsuccessful corner, Fulham rework the ball to the right towards Traore, who chips the ball into the box where Muniz pulls off an unbelievable overhead bicycle kick past Grbic.
Regrouping after a failed corner initially, Fulham work it to Traore who finds some space and then finds Muniz inside the heart of the box.
Great impact from the substitute Traore.
Eight goals in his last eight games for Muniz.
No one has scored more goals than him in the Premier League since the start of February.
Once again, Sheffield United have let a two-goal lead slip.
They were 2-0 up at Bournemouth in their previous game, it ended in a draw.
Deja vu.
Out of nowhere, the Blades are now hanging on.
Grbic at the near post gathers Robinson's effort from the left.
YELLOW! Norwood is booked for an argument with the ref.
Another one! Bassey is booked for a heated argument with Hamer.
Hamer goes into the book too for his clash with Bassey.
Tempers flaring in the dying minutes of this thriller.
Fulham win another corner.
Muniz finds it with a header on the near-post, but hits it straight at Grbic.
YELLOW CARD AGAIN! Bogle this time for a bad foul on Robinson as the defender broke through the halfway line.
So much tension now!
Yet another Fulham corner is dealt with neatly by the Blades.
Soon after, McAtee catches Robinson to gift Fulham a late free-kick on the left edge of the box.
Now Fulham with a chance to seal an incredible victory.
CHANCE! Not too far from a Fulham winner.
The resulting free kick finds an unmarked Cairney on the edge of the box but his low shot is saved by Grbic who will breathe a HUGE sigh of relief.
FULL-TIME: SHEFFIELD UNITED 3-3 FULHAM
And breathe! An incredible six-goal thriller ends in a 3-3 draw between Sheffield United and Fulham at Bramall Lane.
It was a game of two highly contrasting halves.
Fulham dominated so much of the possession in a goalless first-half, during which they missed a host of chances.
Right from the get-go, the second-half seemed like it had all the ingredients to turn this into a thriller.
The Blades took the lead out of nowhere, Fulham equalised in quick time, before United went 3-1 up.
For the second time in as many games, they saw a two-goal lead slip, and it was that man Muniz again for Fulham who hit home the equaliser with a ‘goal of the season’ contender.
Sheffield United earn another point but are still seven points from safety ahead of facing Liverpool next.
Fulham, who face Nottingham Forest next, stay in 12th place with 39 points.
Until next time, goodbye!
